verdict.rationale: Docs state Stripe handles KYC verifications and sanctions screening for onramp transactions and requires wallet-linking for Connect payouts, but there is no documented KYC/KYB API endpoint or explicit programmatic flow for an ops lead to clear a counterparty before money moves. missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB endpoint or object schema, explicit pre-transaction counterparty clearance flow, KYB (business) verification evidence.
